title: Hanasato Minori — Pre-Show Prep〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four, turn...and pose!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I did it!
What do you think, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You've gotten a lot better!
Now all that's left is for you to bear in mind how to make the costume look cuter.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? Costume?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. A proper idol must know how to use their stage costumes to their advantage!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Plan the costume's movements into the dance routine as well and make them look as cute as yourself!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I get it now! You're so good at this, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Admittedly, it's hard to imagine that in our workout gear. We'll have to look for an idol-style costume somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Idol-style costume, huh. Well, we've only just recently decided to form an idol group together, after all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We don't have any official costumes, yet... Ah.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We do have a cute, idol-style costume we can use, Airi!
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank goodness we can still come back!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Miku and Rin really helped us a lot, giving us advice about Haruka and singing the song that was born from our feelings together with us...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Minori, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, there! Anything we can help you with today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We were just practicing our dance routine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we were hoping to improve it by being conscious of the way our costumes moved around during the dance too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So we were wondering if we could use the clothes with the clover motif that we wore when performing here before?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A dance routine that makes your costume look cute... Sounds like something we could learn from, too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We should join in the fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd love that.
May we join you, Minori and Airi?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course you may! Please give us some good pointers, too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's change and practice now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You got it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh... I can't move anymore...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're such a mess.
You should learn from Miku and Rin.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good work, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That was really fun!
I'm glad we could practice together!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Our performances would be more appealing if we could make our costumes look cuter on stage too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it's so difficult to do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's easy to think about making the skirt sway in a cute way, but to actually do it is too hard for me right now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not something you can do right away for sure. Even I still find myself wanting to do better at times.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The more important thing is to actually start thinking about it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Simply doing it for the sake of doing it is meaningless.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Think of the feelings you have towards the song and all of your fans. Without those feelings, you'd just be trying to look cool, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What's truly important is the feelings I put into it, huh? That's the same for interview self-introductions too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, in your case, you have no lack of strong feelings, so all you need to do is work on your expressions by practicing like just now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I'll try my best to learn all sorts of expressions!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Rin! It's almost time for our show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're right! Come on, let's put what we just practiced into use♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. See you later, Minori and Airi.
You're always welcome here♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess we should head back soon too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Do you think I could practice for just a little longer?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, I thought you said you can't move anymore?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm fine now!
I want to be able to have better control over what you just taught me today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's good! Then let's practice until you're satisfied!
